name: Dr. Mustafa Basthikodi
title: Professor & Head, Department of CSE
bio: Dr. Mustafa Basthikodi is Professor and Head of the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at Sahyadri College of Engineering & Management, and Director of Plagzero R&D Solutions. In 2025 he was appointed to the 9th Academic Senate of Visvesvaraya Technological University. As SOSC's faculty coordinator, he guides the community and backs its students' events, hackathons and open-source work.
